origins.section: Every Allowed Plan Is a Point of the Relaxation, So the LP Value Bounds Every Plan
The Integrality Gap Is the Distance From the LP Bound to the Best Plan
Two Correct Formulations Can Have Different Gaps

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-bound-direction: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-bound-direction: When minimizing, the same argument gives z_{LP} \le z_{IP}, a **lower bound**, a floor no plan can go under. The argument uses nothing about GridCap: any MILP and its LP relaxation obey it.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-number: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-number: The **integrality gap** of a model is how far its LP bound sits above the best plan. ... As a share of the best plan ... gap = (z_{LP} - z_{IP}) / |z_{IP}|, which here is (5,250 - 5,000) / 5,000 = 5%.
recorded.prompt:q-formulation: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-formulation: The optimum is the same, as it must be: the 0/1 plans are the same. The LP bound is not. ... A **stronger** (tighter) formulation is one whose LP relaxation allows fewer fractional points while allowing the same 0/1 plans

recorded.outcome:q-bound-direction:b: when maximizing it is an **upper bound**, a ceiling. When minimizing, the same argument gives ... a **lower bound**, a floor. This model minimizes, so 8,200 is a floor, not a ceiling.
recorded.prompt:q-bound-direction:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-bound-direction:d: A number that no plan can beat is a **bound**. The LP value is a bound, not an average of plans.
recorded.prompt:q-gap-number:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-number:b: The gap is measured to the best plan (z_IP), not to a rounded plan: "how far its LP bound sits above the best plan".
recorded.prompt:q-gap-number:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap-number:c: "As a share of the best plan ... it is (z_LP - z_IP)/|z_IP|". The share is of the best plan, not of the bound.
